cds.text: Identify and compare attributes of objects and events (length, capacity, mass, duration) using direct comparison and explain reasoning
Compare directly and indirectly, and order objects and events by length, mass, capacity and duration, explaining reasoning
Measure and compare objects by length, capacity and mass using uniform informal units, and smaller units when more accuracy is needed
Sequence days of the week and times of day and link them to familiar events
Measure lengths of shapes and objects with informal units that are uniform and placed end-to-end
Identify common uses of halves, quarters and eighths with shapes, objects and events, and represent them
Describe the duration and sequence of events using years, months, weeks, days and hours
Identify dates and find the number of days between events using calendars
Recognise and read time on an analog clock to the hour, half-hour and quarter-hour
Identify, describe and show quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns in everyday situations
